 Medusa Festival 
 Medusa Winter Blizzard will not take place on 5 December at IFEMA Madrid: it has been postponed with no new date
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Lucas Moreno 
 21 Nov 2026, 10:15 
 A 2-minute read 
 Medusa Winter 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Medusa Winter Blizzard will not take place on 5 December at IFEMA Madrid : the organisers postponed it on 19 October ‘for logistical and scheduling reasons’. 
 The organisers say they have already refunded the full price of all tickets , without waiting for a new date. 
 There is still no new date : the statement only says they are working on one and will announce it through their official channels. 
 Some listings are still advertising 5 December , including the IFEMA and official Madrid tourism pages, so it is best not to rely on them. 
 Anyone who has Medusa Winter Blizzard pencilled in for Saturday 5 December can take it out of their diary. The Medusa brand's winter event, which was due to make its debut at IFEMA Madrid , has been postponed with no new date since 19 October, when the organisers announced it on their website and on Instagram. Even so, several Madrid listings are still treating the date as confirmed.
 Festival guide 
 Medusa Festival 2027 
 12–16 Aug 2027 · Recinto de conciertos de la playa de Cullera (Medusa), Cullera 
 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 Why Medusa Winter Blizzard has been postponed
 The statement, which now takes up the entire homepage of the event's website, attributes the decision to ‘logistical and scheduling reasons’. The organisers explain that they want to deliver the show with its full visual and staging production and that, in their words, they could not guarantee this on the planned date, so they took the decision ‘out of responsibility’ to those who had bought tickets.
 Blizzard: La Ciudad del Hielo was set to be the first Medusa in Madrid and the brand's first fully indoor event, with a capacity of 9,000 people aged 18 and over. In September, Indira Paganotto and Aarón Sevilla had been announced on the line-up, and tickets were on sale through Enterticket.
 What happens to tickets
 According to the statement, the organisers have proceeded ‘to refund the full price of all tickets’, with no need to wait for a new date to be confirmed. The same message was repeated on Instagram. It has not been stated whether the refund was automatic or whether it includes the ticketing platform's booking fees, so anyone who bought a ticket and cannot see the refund in their account should claim it from Enterticket, the sales channel.
 Will there be a new date?
 The organisers say they are working ‘on a new date for the event’ and will provide updates through their official channels, but five weeks after the announcement they have not announced one. Nor have they said whether they will keep the line-up or the venue. Blizzard is a separate event from Medusa Festival in Cullera , whose 2027 edition is going ahead with its own theme, as we reported in our story on Origyon, the concept for Medusa 2027 .
 Beware of listings still showing 5 December
 News of the postponement has barely spread. As of 21 November, the event page on the IFEMA website and Madrid's official tourism listings were still advertising Blizzard for 5 December, with no notice of any change. The only reliable source is the event's official website, medusawinter.com, which shows only the statement.
 Sources: official statement on medusawinter.com and post by @medusawinter on Instagram (19 October 2026); Madridiario and Madrid24horas (details of the announced event), consulted on 21 November 2026.
